name: Sunset Smile
description:
Penthouse duplex, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, with large terrace, 360-degree panoramic sea views and mountain views in a Mediterranean complex. Located in the centre of The New Golden Mile, close to supermarkets, beach, beach clubs, restaurants, golf courses and towns such as Estepona and Marbella.

The large terrace offers everything for an excellent holiday, from relaxing on the sun loungers during the day to having barbecues at night, dining well and resting in the seating area whilst enjoying impressive panoramic views.

The space

Within walking distance of a beautiful new club with facilities such as: padel courts, fitness, children's club and a restaurant.

The apartment is completely freshly decorated with a fresh style.

Kitchen

Equipped with all necessary services, such as fridge-freezer, oven, microwave, hob, mixer, Nespresso, kettle and washing machine.

Dining area

Dining table for 6 people.

Living room

Cosy living room with smart TV (Netflix, Disney+, etc.) and sliding door to the terrace with mountain and sea views.

Room 1

A double bed (180x200), large fitted wardrobes for clothes, other items and an en-suite bathroom with bathtub, shower, sink and toilet. Views of the sea and mountains.

Room 2

It has 2 single beds (90x200), large built-in wardrobes for clothes and other belongings and views of the sea and the mountain.

Bathroom 2

Equipped with shower, sink and toilet.

Terrace 2

Up the stairs to the large rooftop terrace from back to front and offers 360-degree panoramic views of the sea, mountains and valley. It features a covered terrace area with a dining table for 6 people, a barbecue corner at the back with a Weber gas barbecue and sun loungers. At the front of the terrace, 2 sun loungers, a large walled corner with panoramic views of the sea, mountain and pool.

Other facilities

- High-speed WiFi available (600 Mb).

- Central air conditioning (and heating) in all rooms

- High chair and cot (available upon request)

- Blinds for all windows

- 2 free parking spaces in the free car park

- Lift

- Large swimming pool (shared).

- Gated community with security cameras and security cameras

Services and common areas

- Entire apartment.

- Shared swimming pool (open seasonally)

- Garden.

🏊‍♂The swimming pool is part of the shared facilities of the residential complex and is managed by the community.

We have no control over the opening hours, availability or maintenance decisions of the pool.

Please, keep IN mind that:

* Opening hours and stations may vary and are generally determined by the urban development.

Other notable aspects

Deposit

A refundable deposit of €300 will be required in advance before arrival, authorised on your card via the link sent in the message. This will be released after your stay, provided no damage is reported.

Note: A security deposit of €300 is required, which must be pre-authorised with a valid credit card. The system does not accept debit cards or other payment methods for this process. This pre-authorisation is mandatory and must be completed before arrival.

Renting a car is very useful in this area.
